# AutoTester — snapshot (generated by `autotester snapshot`; do not edit)

**Purpose:** the whole project in one screen — what it is, what is live and why, what changed, what is next.
**Open me when:** every session start (the hook injects me); before picking a unit. For detail go to the router in `CLAUDE.md`.

## Product
Onboard any web product in one form (URL, scoped credentials, optional evals/rules/use cases/sources).
AutoTester learns its flows screen-by-screen, generates **best / worst / edge** cases, and runs in a
**real visible browser** after every dev cycle — so a new feature cannot silently break an old one.
When it meets a screen it does not know, it asks the human for a video instead of guessing.
North star: an expert human tester and AutoTester get the same material and the same build;
AutoTester wins on bugs found, false positives, and time (`schema/bench.py` computes that scorecard).
## Live features
- F-074 **Eval compiler and knowledge graph: every test traces to a user journey** [high] — Eval compiler and knowledge graph: turns each product flow, plus extra multi-step scenarios you name, into runnable test cases. It keeps a map of how screens, flows and scenarios connect, so every test traces back to the user journey it covers, and it lists the screen paths no test covers yet. A whole workflow's result is built up from the results of its parts. · reason: tests were generated one flow at a time, with no map linking them, so a result couldn't be traced to a user journey and coverage gaps weren't visible.
- F-073 **Test catalog: which test kinds apply, which can run, which are blocked and why** [high] — Test catalog: shows which kinds of test case apply to your product, which can run now, and which are blocked and why, each with the one action that unblocks it. Cheap tests run first. It also adds standard test packs for Google/OAuth sign-up, month/year date pickers and Excel column mapping. · reason: previously, test generation never said which cases couldn't run.
- F-072 **Advisory UX findings by user persona (never change PASS/FAIL)** [high] — A project can attach a user persona (role, tech comfort, locale, device); a separate opt-in pass reads a finished run's evidence as that persona and records severity-scored UX findings in their own file and their own export section. The functional verdict stays byte-identical. Not yet called from a real run (AT-794). · reason: Provisional (prefilled by checker for Umesh to confirm or edit): gate meeting-user-persona-ux-judging answered A (D-048) -- UX and comprehension judged beside, never inside, the functional verdict. Event is updated, not live, because no route calls it yet.
- F-071 **Persist and replay the generated script, locating elements by meaning** [high] — A case's generated script is stored and replayed with no model call; elements are found by role, label or the project's declared test-id attributes before CSS, so a renamed CSS class no longer breaks a regression, and a stale or failing replay is reported, never silently healed. · reason: Provisional (prefilled by maker for Umesh to confirm or edit): T-176 task note and D-041 -- competitor A + C: persist the generated script and replay it with semantic locators so a regression run is cheap and does not break on cosmetic CSS changes.
- F-070 **First logged-in Pathlynks run: credential-derived approval, fail-closed on login (AT-529)** [high] — Runs the Pathlynks login case in a real browser with an account-derived, HMAC-signed approval row, re-authors the stale login oracle, and reports a verdict that fails closed (INCONCLUSIVE, AT-529) instead of assuming authentication succeeded. · reason: Provisional (prefilled by maker for Umesh to confirm or edit): T-122 note and D-068 -- the supplied PATHLYNKS_USER_* pair is the run approval, and any run on this path fails closed naming AT-529 rather than assuming authentication succeeded. Originating instruction: Umesh 2026-09-24 'prove it on Pathlynks first' (target.md:145). Known gap filed at close-out: AT-773 (judge can PASS a failed assertion).
- F-069 **Crawl completeness: complete means frontier exhausted, bounds latch before any browser action** [high] — Hybrid BFS plus bounded-DFS traversal, form-input replay, persona-seeded incremental crawl and change tracking (D-040), now with completeness enforced: an aborted, bounded or abandoned crawl can no longer be reported as completed or success, and no browser action runs after a bound has latched. · reason: Complete means frontier exhausted: an aborted, bounded or abandoned crawl can no longer be reported as completed or success, and no browser action (fill, heartbeat, replay) runs after any named bound has latched. Hybrid BFS plus bounded-DFS traversal, form-input replay, persona-seeded incremental crawl and change tracking (D-040). Originating instruction: the 2026-09-30 reopen after an independent checker reproduced AT-113, where a crawl reported completed with an empty frontier and success=true over an aborted_error seed and zero actions.
- F-068 **Read-only target discovery: deterministic signals, classification, markdown context reader** [high] — Scans a target project read-only (credential denylist, path-escape refusal, scrubbed output) and emits deterministic file:line Signals with no model on the signal path; a model may only name the system kind (D-017). A markdown context folder (frontmatter + tags; Obsidian as structured markdown only) feeds the same Signals. Dual-check PASS: coordinator A cycle 2, coordinator B cycle 3. · reason: Provisional (prefilled by maker for Umesh to confirm or edit): T-151 task note and D-017 -- signals by grep/file inspection, never a model, so the classifier can never choose which checks run; every Signal cites a real file:line.
- F-067 **Permission-surface coverage and crawl-global destructive-last ordering** [high] — Reports permitted but unreached controls and their reasons separately from screens reached; deferred destructive controls run after ordinary actions across the crawl. Historical checker PASS cycle 2, not a new acceptance run. · reason: Make permission-limited coverage explicit and preserve crawl-global destructive-last ordering so an incomplete portal crawl cannot look fully tested.
